ablation_metrics.stage: 2. Local Native CoastSat 2D (Tide-Only, As-Is Marching Squares + ±25m)
3. Local Native CoastSat 2D + CDIP 045 Wave Runup + CoastSat.slope (As-Is)
4. Local Native CoastSat.PlanetScope 2D + CDIP 045 Wave + Slope (As-Is)

sensor_comparison.role: Long-term historical reference shoreline (x_ref) & seasonal baseline
sensor_comparison.limitation: 30 m pixel mixes wet sand, swash & riprap on narrow (<30 m) Oceanside beaches; 16-day revisit misses storm peaks.

sensor_comparison.role: Native 2D Marching Squares MNDWI contour + ±25m alongshore intersection + CDIP 045 wave runup
sensor_comparison.limitation: 10 m pixel (20 m SWIR) cannot resolve <10 m riprap pinch-points; 5-day revisit misses rapid 1–4 day post-storm recovery.

sensor_comparison.role: Native 2D CoastSat.PlanetScope (4-class + 1:1 sl_extract + Marching Squares >=30m + ±25m intersection) + AROSICS
sensor_comparison.limitation: 865 nm NIR lacks SWIR band, remaining sensitive to low-tide (-0.08 m) shallow bottom reflectance on submerged bars.

sensor_comparison.role: In-situ NAVD88 elevation profiles & MHW (1.344 m) ground truth
sensor_comparison.limitation: Labor-intensive field survey; Oct 29, 2023 survey lost RTK lock ('Single Signal all survey').
